limitations: A sequence is a source-order listing of callees; a runtime branch that takes a different path is invisible.
A short sequence (<= 2 calls) is too common to be a signal; it is filtered out.
A cluster requires at least three occurrences by default; near-duplicate pairs are common noise.
Only languages with a parsed tree produce sequences; unparsed files stay out of the denominator.

summary.interpretation: A cluster contains functions that perform the same ordered list of callees. The cluster is a hypothesis; one shared list may be coincidence or coordination copy.
